recall_scene.name: Recall scene
recall_scene.description: Recall a scene of a Helvar group, also scenes without a name (e.g. what a button panel does).

group.name: Group
group.description: Helvar group number, e.g. 4 for 4 Woonkamer alles.

block.name: Block
block.description: Scene block (1-8). Button panels normally use block 1.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Scene number in the block (1-16). 15 is usually 'off'.

fade_time.name: Fade time
fade_time.description: Fade time in seconds. Omit to use the default.
